# Masterstroke Academy

> India's structured blockchain developer program - 4 phases, 21 modules,
> 130+ hours. Live code execution on MST Chain (EVM-compatible hybrid
> Layer-1 blockchain). On-chain verifiable certificate on completion.
> Operated by Masterstroke Technosoft Private Limited.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://masterstroke.academy/): Overview of the blockchain developer program
- [Curriculum](https://masterstroke.academy/academy-overview): Full syllabus - all 4 phases, 21 modules, 123 submodules
- [Learning Path](https://masterstroke.academy/learn): Interactive module tree with progress tracking
- [Leaderboard](https://masterstroke.academy/leaderboard): Top performer rankings and streaks
- [Enroll](https://masterstroke.academy/register): Free and Fellowship enrollment plans
- [FAQ](https://masterstroke.academy/academy-overview#faq): Complete answers to common questions
- [Blog](https://masterstroke.academy/blogs): Solidity tutorials, Web3 career guides, DeFi explainers

## Facts

- Course name: Professional Blockchain Developer Program
- Structure: 4 phases, 21 modules, 123 submodules, 130+ hours total
- Blockchain used: MST Chain, EVM-compatible hybrid Layer-1 built for India
- Assessment pass rate required: 70% per submodule to unlock next lesson
- Certificate type: On-chain, verifiable, issued on MST Blockchain
- Funding path: Top capstone projects eligible for MST ecosystem grants up to $50,000 USD
- Pricing model: Free-to-start, paid Fellowship tier for full access + internship eligibility
- Topics covered: Cryptography, EVM, Solidity, Hardhat, Web3.js, DeFi, NFTs (ERC-721/1155), DAOs, ZK Proofs, RWA tokenisation, smart contract security auditing
- Target audience: Engineering students, developers, and career-changers in India
- Operator: Masterstroke Technosoft Private Limited

## Phase Breakdown

- Phase 1 - The Internet, Decentralisation & Blockchain Foundation (4 modules, ~18 hours)
- Phase 2 - The MST Difference & Developer Tooling (4 modules, ~20 hours)
- Phase 3 - Core Project: Building Your Startup MVP (9 modules, ~70 hours)
- Phase 4 - From Developer to Funded Founder/Intern: Grants, Pitch & Career (4 modules, ~22 hours)
